coverage.what_it_means: Every saving above is a share of a baseline priced on 1.000 of its own scope. That baseline is complete.

savings_bridge.note: 11 step(s) in the order they compound - each acts on what the ones before it left, so they do not add up to the sum of their percentages. 1 lever(s) had a baseline and matched nothing in this estate.

confidence.arithmetic: capped = min(sum(component x weight), min(component) + component_cap_headroom). If v0_status is PARTIAL, capped is lowered one band: to (next lower band floor - 0.01) where the score is at or above a floor, otherwise to capped x partial_penalty_factor. overall = clamp of the result. Ceilings in `ceilings_applied` have already been applied to the components above.

coverage.unpriced_scope_basis: circuit count; no approved rate exists for these products in any country, so their value is unknown rather than zero
